name: io.github.jackuait/blok-mcp
description: Read and edit Blok documents from an MCP client.

environmentVariables.name: BLOK_DOC_ENDPOINT_AUTH
environmentVariables.description: Authorization header for the endpoint source.

environmentVariables.name: BLOK_SYNC_URL
environmentVariables.description: Sync service for live rooms, as --sync-url.

environmentVariables.name: BLOK_MCP_ORIGIN
environmentVariables.description: Origin sent to the sync service, as --origin.

environmentVariables.name: BLOK_TICKET_URL
environmentVariables.description: Host route that mints room tickets, as --ticket-url.

environmentVariables.name: BLOK_MCP_HOST_TOKEN
environmentVariables.description: Bearer token for the ticket route. Required with it.

environmentVariables.name: BLOK_MCP_HTTP
environmentVariables.description: Serve Streamable HTTP on host:port, as --http.

environmentVariables.name: BLOK_RICH_TEXT_FIELDS
environmentVariables.description: Rich text fields for unknown block types, as --rich-text-fields.
